priority.description:
The priority for invalidation queue entries generated by the job.  When null, the priority will be that specified
in @invalidationQueueOptions(priority).  This field will be modified by the setPriority function to override the
default.  Avoid setting manually as that will not update the priority of already submitted invalidations.

disabled.description:
Indicates that the job is in the disabled state meaning that no queue entries will be processed for the job.
This should only be set manually when initially creating/starting the job.  To disable/enable a running job call
{@link disable}/{@link enable}.

maxConcurrency.description:
The maximum number of invalidation queue entries that will be processed simultaneously for a job.  If -1, no limit
is applied. This is enforced independently of {@link maxConcurrencyPerNode}.

maxConcurrencyPerNode.description:
The maximum number of invalidation queue entries that will be processed simultaneously for a job per node.  If -1,
no limit is applied.  This is enforced independently of {@link maxConcurrency}.

runAsUser.description:
If true, the appropriate functions (e.g. map/reduce in MapReduce and processBatch in BatchJob) will be run as the
user who started the job.  If false, they will be run as root.

nodePool.description:
When non-null, invalidation queue entries for the job will only be processed by servers with a matching
nodePool.  When null, invalidation queue entries for the job will only be processed by servers from default
nodePool.

skipIfRunning.description:
If true, attempts to start the job will be ignored if it is already running and no error will be thrown.  This is useful,
for instance, if a cron job starts a job and the job from a previous cron invocation may not have completed before the next
scheduled run.

If false, an error will be thrown if an attempt is made to start the job if it is already running.

numAutoRecoveryAttempts.description: Set to between 1 and 5 to enable auto recovery. See {@link invalidation-queues.c3doc Invalidation Queues} for detailed documentation.

createdOrUpdated.description:
True if the created or updated function should be called.  If true and the type being refreshed
has both the created and updated function defined, only the updated function will be called.  If only
one of the functions is defined, then it will be called.

storedCalcs.description: True if stored calc dependencies should be refreshed.

hierarchies.description: True if hierarchy denorm dependencies should be refreshed.

acls.description: True if acl dependencies should be refreshed.

partitionableCompaction.description:
True if partitionable types should be compacted. This is important for initial load since it will re-arrange (compact)
all the columns for types that are {@link Partitionable} and are stored in kv stores. This will directly impact
read performance from these types

normalizedTimeseries.description: True if dependent timeseries should be normalized.

metricDeps.description: True if metric dependencies should be refreshed.

analytics.description: True if analytics for source Objs identified by metrics should be refreshed.

metrics.description: True if cached metrics should be refreshed.

invalidationsBatchSize.description: Number of entries to submit to the invalidation queue at one time for async call.

createdOrUpdatedBatchSize.description: Number of ids to include in range id search for each invalidation request for for async call to {@link createdOrUpdated}.

storedCalcsBatchSize.description: Number of ids to include in range id search for each invalidation request for for async call to {@link storedCalcs}.

hierarchiesBatchSize.description: Number of ids to include in range id search for each invalidation request for for async call to {@link hierarchies}.

aclsBatchSize.description: Number of ids to include in range id search for each invalidation request for for async call to {@link acls}.

partitionableCompactionBatchSize.description: Number of ids to include in range id search for each invalidation request for for async call to {@link partitionableCompaction}.

normalizedTimeseriesBatchSize.description: Number of ids to include in range id search for each invalidation request for for async call to {@link normalizedTimeseries}.

metricDepsBatchSize.description: Number of ids to include in range id search for each invalidation request for for async call to {@link metricDeps}.

analyticsBatchSize.description: Number of ids to include in range id search for each invalidation request for for async call to {@link analytics}.

metricsBatchSize.description: Number of ids to include in range id search for each invalidation request for {@link metrics}.

createdOrUpdatedSubBatchSize.description: Number of objs to operate on in synchronous call for {@link createdOrUpdated}.  When specified in async call, the value is passed in to subsequent synchronous call.

storedCalcsSubBatchSize.description: Number of objs to operate on in synchronous call for {@link storedCalcs}.  When specified in async call, the value is passed in to subsequent synchronous call.

hierarchiesSubBatchSize.description: Number of objs to operate on in synchronous call for {@link hierarchies}.  When specified in async call, the value is passed in to subsequent synchronous call.

aclsSubBatchSize.description: Number of objs to operate on in synchronous call for {@link acls}.  When specified in async call, the value is passed in to subsequent synchronous call.

partitionableCompactionSubBatchSize.description: Number of objs to operate on in synchronous call for {@link partitionableCompaction}.  When specified in async call, the value is passed in to subsequent synchronous call.

normalizedTimeseriesSubBatchSize.description: Number of objs to operate on in synchronous call for {@link normalizedTimeseries}.  When specified in async call, the value is passed in to subsequent synchronous call.

metricDepsSubBatchSize.description: Number of objs to operate on in synchronous call for {@link metricDeps}.  When specified in async call, the value is passed in to subsequent synchronous call.

analyticsSubBatchSize.description: Number of objs to operate on in synchronous call for {@link analytics}.  When specified in async call, the value is passed in to subsequent synchronous call.

metricsSubBatchSize.description: Number of objs to operate on in synchronous call for {@link metrics}.  When specified in async call, the value is passed in to subsequent synchronous call.

initialLoad.description:
Only used when {@link metricDeps} is specified.  If true, all instances of {@link MetricDependency} will be
removed prior to rebuilding them.  If false, existing entries will remain.

Important!: Note that if there are a lot of existing entries, removing them may take a very long time.

dontAllowDataIssues.description:
By default, certain errors (e.g. stored calc array overflow) are handled by creating {@link CalcFieldIssue} entries
rather than causing the rebuild operation to fail.  Set this to true to cause those errors to fail the rebuild
process instead.
